steps.label: Scriptable
steps.sub: save it in a file, rerun it, automate it

steps.label: Repeatable
steps.sub: the tenth run matches the first, no misclicks

steps.label: Fast
steps.sub: one command instead of ten clicks across three menus

code:
az login                              # sign in
az account show                       # which subscription am I in?
az group create --name rg-demo \
  --location eastus                   # create a resource group
az group list                         # see all resource groups
az vm list                            # see all virtual machines
caption: Every one of these maps to something you already know conceptually.

eyebrow: Reading a command, piece by piece
code:
az        group create   --name rg-demo   --location eastus
|         |              |                |
CLI tool  the action     a parameter      a parameter

Shape: az <service> <action> --<parameter> <value>
caption: Once this pattern clicks, new commands stop being intimidating.
